concepts.title: DNA replication in vitro
concepts.quote: PCR is an in vitro laboratory technique that takes advantage of the natural process of DNA replication.

concepts.title: Heat-stable polymerases
concepts.quote: The heat-stable DNA polymerase enzymes used in PCR are derived from hyperthermophilic prokaryotes.

concepts.title: Primer chemistry
concepts.quote: However, while primers composed of RNA are normally used in cells, DNA primers are used for PCR.

concepts.title: PCR cycle stages
concepts.quote: PCR occurs over multiple cycles, each containing three steps: denaturation, annealing, and extension.
